Job Title: Software Engineer, Classification Systems (JavaScript) 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity 
Join CACI as part of the MWIII Bridge program supporting Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities across the enterprise and stand‑alone deployments within the Intelligence Community. Based in Hanover, MD, this mission‑driven work spans program management, software development, systems engineering, testing, integration, migration, documentation, and release management.  As a Software Engineer on the ClassifyIT team, you will help enhance and extend classification‑marking tools that support both existing mission systems and emerging M365‑based applications. You’ll contribute to full‑lifecycle development and collaborate with a talented team focused on delivering secure, policy‑driven software across multiple fabrics.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and document software capabilities that support classification marking and access‑control validation.

 Extend and customize tools for classification string validation, comparison, and enforcement.

 Work with a team of developers to implement new features for current and M365‑based classification tools.

 Participate fully in requirements elicitation, technical discussions, and decision‑making throughout the software lifecycle.

 Collaborate closely in an established team environment and work directly with customers when needed

 Contribute to the creation and execution of functional tests, unit tests, and code reviews.

 Troubleshoot issues and support continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards.

 
 Qualifications 
 Required 
 TS/SCI clearance with polygraph

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or 4 years of additional software engineering experience in lieu of degree, totaling 7 years)

 3+ years of software engineering experience

 Strong working knowledge of JavaScript/DOM, TypeScript, Node.js/npm

 Experience with AWS services and dashboards

 Hands‑on experience using Docker (including converting applications to Docker images)

 Experience with Git (command line), GitLab CI, and GitLab pipelines

 Familiarity with Jest and Cypress

 Experience developing unit and functional tests

 Experience conducting code reviews

 Ability to work directly with customers and within established team processes

 Strong troubleshooting skills

 Ability to follow coding standards and team policies

 
 Desired 
 Experience gathering, analyzing, and capturing customer requirements

 Ability to contribute to requirements for new features and defect fixes

 Experience creating and expanding unit tests

 Knowledge of the Microsoft Office JavaScript API

 Ability to triage, track, and respond to user questions and issues

 Experience testing new software releases and merge requests

 Experience collaborating with developers, contractors, and Government stakeholders

 Ability to contribute to high‑level documentation and user guides

 Strong time‑management skills

 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$94,400 - $198,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
